summary: The source PDF labels this table's two budget columns "2025 Budget" and "2026 Budget", but the figures are the 2026 and 2027 budgets, so Pittsburgh Budget Explorer shows them as "2026 Budget" and "2027 Budget".
evidence: The "2025 Budget" column equals the 2026 budget document's 2026 Budget exactly (revenue $9,255,231; 51101 Regular $3,694,238; 91108 Project Fund-Out $1,391,562). The "2026 Budget" column matches the 2027 figures in the same section's personnel tables (51101 Regular $3,810,334 here vs. a full-time 2027 budget of $3,810,332 there).
